gloss: upper body, upper half of the body

definitions.gloss: upper body, upper half of the body
definitions.explanation: The upper portion of the human body, roughly from the waist up, including the chest, arms, and head.

examples.japanese: {上半身|じょうはんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。
{上半身|じょうはんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こして→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I raised my upper body and sat up.

examples.japanese: ⟦レントゲン→レントゲン：11219_rentogen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{上半身|じょうはんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}して→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧、⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: They took an X-ray of my upper body to check for any abnormalities.

notes:
The upper half of the human body, roughly from the waist up. Used in fitness, medicine, and everyday descriptions.

FORMS:
⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (upper) + {半身|はんしん} (half the body).

- {上半身|じょうはんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train the upper body
- {上半身|じょうはんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to raise the upper body (sit up)
- {上半身|じょうはんしん}⟦{裸|はだか}→裸：03692_hadaka⟧: naked from the waist up
